Google Maps: 620 Douglas St # 210, Sioux City, IA 51101

Key Departments and Services

Recorder’s Office and Record Access

  • Obtain vital records and historical documents from 1880–1970 in-person.
  • Online records are accessible via name and state searches.

Payment Options

  • In-Person: Visit during working hours for cash or card payments.
  • Online: Use the Iowa Courts Payment Portal.
  • Mail: Send a check to 620 Douglas St # 210, Sioux City, IA 51101, USA.

Court Services

District Court

Handles cases like:

  • Criminal
  • Civil
  • Family matters
  • Small claims
  • Traffic violations
    For inquiries, contact Peggy Frericks at 712-279-6035 or peggy.frericks@iowacourts.gov.

Juvenile Court

Specializes in:

  • Child in need of assistance cases
  • Parental rights terminations
  • Delinquency cases
  • Adoptions
  • Child commitment proceedings
    For details, visit 822 Douglas St, Room 201, Sioux City, IA 51101, or call 712-279-6586.

Supreme Court

Functions as an appellate court for case reviews and appeals. Located at 1111 East Court Avenue, Des Moines, IA 50319.

Marriage License

  • Fee: $35
  • Requirements: Both applicants must be present with photo ID and be 18+.
  • Valid for one year after issuance.
    For details, contact 712-279-6528.

Employment Opportunities

Explore career options at the Woodbury County Courthouse career page. Jobs are updated monthly, offering competitive salaries and benefits like health insurance.

Little Courthouse

A tax department courthouse near Anthon Post Office and Heritage Bank N.A.

  • Hours: 8:00 AM–12:45 PM & 1:30 PM–4:30 PM (Monday-Friday)
  • Phone: 712-373-5238

Frequently Asked Questions

What types of family law cases are handled?

  • Divorce (with or without children)
  • Legal separation
  • Paternity cases
  • Child custody and support

How do I contact the sheriff’s office?

Phone: 712-279-6010

What is the parking fee?

Fee: $0.25 for 20 minutes. Parking is available on the street.

What clothing is allowed in court?

Business attire is recommended. Avoid sleeveless shirts, torn pants, or offensive prints.
